First public build.

**Features**
- Paste a Spotify playlist, album, track, or user-profile URL and resolve its metadata
- Download tracks via Deezer (with an ARL cookie) or a yt-dlp/YouTube fallback
- Automatic ID3 tagging and embedded artwork
- Library organized into `Playlists/`, `Albums/`, `Tracks/` folders – plain MP3 files, no lock-in
- Refresh a source to pick up new or removed tracks; retry failed downloads, including with a manual link
- Runs as a desktop web app or as an Android app (this release) – same backend, same UI
